answer: Like water carving a karst system, every attestation an agent performs etches a permanent, unforgeable record into its identity. New identities climb a slow-growth vine of trust: their reputation delta per epoch is capped, so standing grows only through verifiable work over time. A sybil swarm gets no shortcut — each fake identity must individually earn its history at full cost, which makes large-scale identity forgery economically worthless.
